fato_historico: 1794: French Revolutionary Wars: Arthur Wellesley (later Duke of Wellington) sees his first combat at the Battle of Boxtel during the Flanders Campaign.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a call to courage, Leo. Much like a young hero stepping into the fires of history for the first time, you are invited to stand your ground with grace. Consider this a perfect moment to lead with kindness, as your natural confidence can transform any obstacle into a golden milestone of personal growth.
frase_do_dia: True strength shines brightest when it is guided by a warm and noble heart.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of wisdom and the unfolding of new personal cycles.
conselho: Trust your instincts and face your challenges with the steady dignity of a lion.
